pictures.name: JSP1-Twelve-Scouts
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Dawn at the edge of a desert camp of dark tents. Twelve men in travel cloaks of different earthy colors, with staffs and water skins, walk away from us into green hills rising beyond the desert, seen from behind. On a rocky rise far to one side stands Moses, a tiny far-off figure in a dark robe with a staff, seen only from behind or far away, watching them go. Gold dawn light, long blue shadows, a sense of a journey beginning.

pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Late afternoon, scouts returning to the desert camp. In the middle, two strong men carry between them a wooden pole on their shoulders with one enormous, heavy cluster of purple grapes hanging from it. Others carry baskets of red pomegranates and figs. Curious people in rich robes gather around. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows.

pictures.name: JSP3-Grasshoppers
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Evening in the desert camp. A group of ten anxious scouts in travel cloaks speak to a worried crowd, one with his hands raised to show something huge. Behind them, in a dreamlike haze on the horizon, towering walled cities and giant shadowy figures loom far larger than life. A small green grasshopper sits on a stone in the foreground. Torchlight gold, deep blue night.

Night in the desert camp. Two scouts, seen from behind, stand on a low rock facing a large crowd, one holding up a red pomegranate. Around the campfires, families weep and huddle in fear. Warm firelight gold against deep blue night, tension and courage.

Today: a small modern synagogue chapel in early morning, painted in the same oil style. In the middle, a mourner, a man in his sixties with a grey beard and a dark jacket, stands with a prayer book.
